The SVG path uses two elliptical arc commands with the same radii (16.51, 16.51), sweep flags set to 0, and large-arc flags set to 1, forming a closed shape by connecting two arcs. Since the x-radius and y-radius are equal (16.51), the arcs are circular arcs, not elliptical. The path starts and ends at the same point after tracing two arcs, creating a full circle.  

Final answer: (A)
